'''Vanbec Recliva''' was a [[Kessurian]] member of a dance troupe, alongside [[Sylphanie Stil]] and [[Charlu Sisi]]. The dance troupe, including Recliva, visited [[Pasaana]] for the [[Aki-Aki]] [[Festival of the Ancestors]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vanbec Reclica first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> where they were portrayed by [[Rebecca Van Cleave]],<ref name="Private Signings">{{WebCite|url=https://www.privatesignings.org/product-category/rebecca-van-cleave|text=Rebecca Van Cleave|archivedate=20220510214549}} {{C|Note: Among the pictures that can be chosen for signing, are photos of the three members of the [[Kessurian]] dance troupe from {{Film|IX}}. The other two members, [[Sylphanie Stil]] and [[Charlu Sisi]], are played by [[Stephanie Silva]] and [[Charlotte Louise]], respectively; meaning that [[Rebecca Van Cleave]] plays Vanbec Recliva.}}</ref> who is listed as "creature and droid puppeteer" in the film's credits.<ref name="TROS" /> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and released alongside the film on [[December 20]], 2019.<ref name="Penguin Random House">{{Penguin|url=books/607902/star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-the-visual-dictionary-by-pablo-hidalgo|text=Star Wars The Rise of Skywalker The Visual Dictionary}}</ref> The character's name<ref name="TROS VD" /> serves as a [[tuckerization]] of the actress' name.<ref name="Private Signings" /> 

Costume concept art for the character was created by [[Calum Alexander Watt]] in [[2018]] based on previous concept art created by [[Jake Lunt Davies]]<ref name="Costume concept">{{Twitter|CalumAWatt|status/1306907244743847939|[[Calum Alexander Watt]]|date=2020-09-18|quote=Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, costume concept art for Pasaana crowd, Kessurian Dance Troupe, 2018. Original creature design by Jake Lunt Davies. This one doesn't appear in the book, so thanks to @PhilSzostak for permission to share here.|archivedate=20220204214614|nolive=1}}</ref> for a potential [[Kijimi]] resident in the film<ref name="LuntDavies">{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|status/1306917645913133056|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-09-18|quote=Cool. And cooler with the firepower - shame they weren't a bit more bad ass in the end. I originally drew the design to go into Kijimi so had her all in furs.|archivedate=20200918112855|nolive=1}}</ref> with the production codes "Wizard 56"<ref name="Art of TROS">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> and "Anchorage 09c" and the nickname "Red Horn Girl".<ref name="JLD-IG">{{Instagram|url=p/CDCmt8BjS--|username=jakeluntdavies|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-07-24|quote=According to the good old DK Visual Guide she’s a Kessurian. When I drew her she was just Anchorage 09c aka Red Horn Girl. #starwars #theriseofskywalker #conceptdesign #conceptart #conceptartist #prostheticmakeup #alien #girl #red|archivefile=File:Kessurian concept art-JakeLuntDavies.png}}</ref> Watt was unaware the characters were meant to be dancers and so drew them armed with [[rifle]]s.<ref name="Artillery">{{Twitter|CalumAWatt|status/1306908397913214978|[[Calum Alexander Watt]]|date=2020-09-18|quote=I wasn't aware they were to be dancers, hence all the artillery! The below image is taken from the Visual Dictionary|archivedate=20200918105045|nolive=1}}</ref> The species' look was achieved through prosthetic makeup.<ref name="Makeup-IG">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/B9z-g9ujWl2|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-03-17|quote=Alien design by me for Rise of a Skywalker. Not sure she ever made it into the final cut. 🤷♂️. Performed by Latesha Wilson @gingin_90, prosthetic makeup by @lizbarlowmakeup in 2nd pic. Also should say sculpted by @maudiebradyart.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/UWa8p|archivefile=File:WilsonWilsa.png}}</ref>
